<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="Heliovolt — a deep dive into high-efficiency solar cells, with a detailed focus on multi-junction photovoltaics, how they work, records, and applications.">
<title>Heliovolt · High-Efficiency Solar Cells</title>
<script>
/* Apply saved theme before first paint (dark is the default). */
(function(){try{if(localStorage.getItem("heliovolt-theme")==="light"){document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme","light")}}catch(e){}})();
</script>
<style>
/* ============================================================
   HELIOVOLT — design tokens
   Default: dark theme. Light theme via [data-theme="light"]
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:            #0a0e13;
  --bg-soft:       #0f151d;
  --panel:         #121a24;
  --panel-2:       #17212e;
  --line:          #24313f;
  --line-soft:     #1b2530;
  --text:          #e9eef4;
  --muted:         #97a4b3;
  --faint:         #667484;
  --accent:        #ffb547;
  --accent-2:      #ff7847;
  --accent-soft:   rgba(255,181,71,.12);
  --cyan:          #5ad1e6;
  --glow:          rgba(255,160,60,.25);
  --shadow:        0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  --hero-grid:     rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  --sun-core:      rgba(255,190,90,.55);
  --sun-halo:      rgba(255,140,60,.14);
  --code-bg:       #0c1219;
  --track:         #223041;
  --nav-bg:        rgba(10,14,19,.82);
}
[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:            #f5f3ee;
  --bg-soft:       #efede6;
  --panel:         #ffffff;
  --panel-2:       #faf8f3;
  --line:          #ddd6c8;
  --line-soft:     #e8e3d8;
  --text:          #1c242e;
  --muted:         #5a6674;
  --faint:         #8a94a0;
  --accent:        #d97706;
  --accent-2:      #e05233;
  --accent-soft:   rgba(217,119,6,.10);
  --cyan:          #0e7490;
  --glow:          rgba(217,119,6,.18);
  --shadow:        0 24px 50px -28px rgba(60,45,20,.35);
  --hero-grid:     rgba(20,30,45,.05);
  --sun-core:      rgba(255,170,60,.5);
  --sun-halo:      rgba(255,150,50,.18);
  --code-bg:       #f1eee6;
  --track:         #e3ddcf;
  --nav-bg:        rgba(245,243,238,.84);
}

/* ============================================================
   Base
   ============================================================ */
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Inter,Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  line-height:1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  transition:background .45s ease,color .45s ease;
}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#141005}
img{max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono","Cascadia Code",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

h1,h2,h3,h4{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.15}
.kicker{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:18px;
}
.kicker::before{content:"";width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--accent)}
.section{padding:110px 0;position:relative}
.section h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.5rem);margin-bottom:16px}
.section .lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.06rem;max-width:64ch}

/* Skip link */
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;z-index:200;background:var(--accent);color:#141005;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:600}
.skip:focus{left:12px}

/* ============================================================
   Navigation
   ============================================================ */
.nav{
  position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:100;
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  background:var(--nav-bg);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:border-color .3s,background .45s;
}
.nav.scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.nav-inner{
  max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  height:66px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-size:1.06rem}
.brand-mark{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;position:relative;flex:none;
  background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2),#ffd77a,var(--accent));
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px -4px var(--glow);
}
.brand-mark::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:7px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);
  transition:background .45s;
}
.brand-mark::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:11px;border-radius:2px;z-index:1;
  background:var(--accent);opacity:.9;
}
.brand small{font-weight:500;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.62rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin-left:2px}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;font-weight:500;
  padding:8px 13px;border-radius:8px;transition:color .2s,background .2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--accent-soft)}
.nav-links a.hot{color:var(--accent)}

/* Theme toggle */
.theme-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);
  font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;
  transition:border-color .2s,background .3s,transform .15s;
}
.theme-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.theme-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none}
.theme-btn .sun-ic{color:var(--accent)}
.theme-btn .moon-ic{color:var(--muted)}
/* Dark mode (default): show sun — "switch to light". Light mode: show moon — "switch to dark". */
.theme-btn .moon-ic{display:none}
[data-theme="light"] .theme-btn .moon-ic{display:block}
[data-theme="light"] .theme-btn .sun-ic{display:none}
.theme-btn .label-light{display:none}
[data-theme="light"] .theme-btn .label-dark{display:none}
[data-theme="light"] .theme-btn .label-light{display:inline}

/* Mobile nav */
.nav-burger{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:840px){
  .nav-burger{display:block}
  .nav-links{
    position:fixed;top:66px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;
    background:var(--bg-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:10px 18px 16px;display:none;
  }
  .nav-links.open{display:flex}
  .nav-links a{padding:12px 14px;font-size:.95rem}
}

/* ============================================================
   Hero
   ============================================================ */
.hero{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  padding:170px 0 90px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--hero-grid) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,var(--hero-grid) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:52px 52px;
}
.hero::before{ /* sun */
  content:"";position:absolute;top:-190px;right:-120px;width:560px;height:560px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--sun-core) 0%,var(--sun-halo) 42%,transparent 70%);
  animation:breathe 9s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.9}50%{transform:scale(1.08);opacity:1}}
.hero-inner{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.2vw,3.9rem);
  letter-spacing:-.035em;margin-bottom:22px;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1rem;max-width:54ch;margin-bottom:34px}
.cta-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:52px}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .25s,background .25s,border-color .2s;
}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-primary{
  background:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:#181004;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px var(--glow);
}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 38px -10px var(--glow)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--text);background:transparent}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* Hero stat strip */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.stat{background:var(--panel);padding:18px 20px;transition:background .45s}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:1.45rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.2}
.stat span{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4;display:block;margin-top:3px}

/* Hero visual: stylized PV module */
.panel-stage{position:relative;perspective:1100px}
.panel-frame{
  position:relative;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a3644,#141c26);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  transform:rotateY(-14deg) rotateX(8deg);
  transition:transform .6s ease,background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
[data-theme="light"] .panel-frame{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3c4a5c,#222c38)}
.panel-frame:hover{transform:rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(5deg)}
.panel-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px;
  height:340px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;
}
.cell{
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(200deg,#123048,#0b1a2a 70%);
  border:1px solid rgba(120,180,255,.14);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cell::after{ /* busbar lines */
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 46%,rgba(180,215,255,.22) 48%,rgba(180,215,255,.22) 52%,transparent 54%);
}
.panel-frame::after{ /* shimmer sweep */
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:9px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,210,130,.16) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 50%,rgba(255,210,130,.16) 52%,transparent 70%);
  transform:translateX(-120%);animation:sweep 6.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sweep{0%,55%{transform:translateX(-120%)}85%,100%{transform:translateX(120%)}}
.panel-caption{
  position:absolute;bottom:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  white-space:nowrap;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;
}

@media (max-width:920px){
  .hero{padding-top:130px}
  .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:64px}
  .panel-stage{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .panel-grid{height:260px}
}

/* ============================================================
   Reveal on scroll
   ============================================================ */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.reveal.d2{transition-delay:.16s}
.reveal.d3{transition-delay:.24s}.reveal.d4{transition-delay:.32s}

/* ============================================================
   Section: why efficiency / overview
   ============================================================ */
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:52px}
.card{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:28px 26px;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.card .ico{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:18px;
}
.card .ico svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.card h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem}
@media (max-width:840px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   Section: technologies
   ============================================================ */
#technologies{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);transition:background .45s}
.tech-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:52px}
.tech{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.tech:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.tech .tag{
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);
}
.tech h3{font-size:1.05rem}
.tech p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;flex:1}
.tech .eff{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:14px;
}
.tech .eff b{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--cyan)}
.tech .eff span{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--faint)}
.tech.featured{
  grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--panel) 55%);
  border-color:var(--accent);
}
[data-theme="light"] .tech.featured{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),#fff 55%)}
.tech.featured h3{font-size:1.35rem}
.tech.featured .deep{
  align-self:center;justify-self:start;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:var(--accent);color:#181004;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;
  font-size:.86rem;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .25s;
}
.tech.featured .deep:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow)}
@media (max-width:840px){
  .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tech.featured{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tech.featured .deep{align-self:start;justify-self:start}
}

/* Efficiency bar chart */
.chart{margin-top:64px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:34px 34px 26px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.chart h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.chart .note{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:26px}
.bar-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(120px,220px) 1fr 64px;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.bar-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.bar-label{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bar-track{background:var(--track);height:14px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bar-fill{
  height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
  transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.bar-fill.cool{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3ba7c9,var(--cyan))}
.bar-val{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.9rem;text-align:right;color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .bar-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 54px;grid-template-areas:"l l" "t v"}
  .bar-label{grid-area:l}.bar-track{grid-area:t}.bar-val{grid-area:v}
}

/* ============================================================
   Section: multi-junction (the focus)
   ============================================================ */
#multi{position:relative}
#multi::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:min(900px,90%);height:220px;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,var(--sun-halo),transparent 70%);
}
.mj-head{max-width:760px;margin-bottom:20px}
.mj-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,2.9rem)}

/* Anchor targets sit below the fixed nav */
section[id],div[id="records"]{scroll-margin-top:86px}

/* --- Stack diagram --- */
.mj-diagram{
  margin-top:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:34px;align-items:start;
}
@media (max-width:920px){
  .mj-diagram{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stack{max-width:440px}
}
.stack-panel{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;
  padding:30px 26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
.sun-arrow{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--accent);font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.sun-arrow .ray{width:2px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(var(--accent),transparent);animation:ray 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ray{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:translateY(-2px)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(3px)}}
.stack{position:relative;margin:6px auto 4px;max-width:520px}
.layer{
  position:relative;border-radius:10px;margin:0 auto 0;width:100%;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;
  padding:0 18px;
}
.layer .name{font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
.layer .name small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem}
.layer .gap{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);opacity:.85;white-space:nowrap}
.layer.contact{
  background:var(--panel-2);height:38px;justify-content:center;
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
}
.sub1{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(124,110,255,.34),rgba(124,110,255,.16));border-color:rgba(140,130,255,.5)}
.sub2{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,122,60,.36),rgba(255,122,60,.16));border-color:rgba(255,140,80,.5)}
.sub3{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(230,57,70,.34),rgba(230,57,70,.16));border-color:rgba(240,80,90,.5)}
.tunnel{
  height:12px;margin:0 auto;width:82%;border-radius:4px;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--faint) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px);
  opacity:.55;position:relative;
}
.tunnel::after{
  content:"tunnel junction";position:absolute;right:calc(-1 * 100% + 8px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--faint);
  text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;display:none;
}
.stack-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stack-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted)}
.dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.dot.v{background:#7c6eff}.dot.o{background:#ff7a3c}.dot.r{background:#e63946}

/* photons animation */
.photon{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-16px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
  box-shadow:0 0 12px 3px currentColor;
}
.ph1{color:#8f83ff;background:#b7b0ff;animation:ph1 4.2s linear infinite .3s}
.ph2{color:#ff9a55;background:#ffc49a;animation:ph2 4.2s linear infinite 1.1s}
.ph3{color:#ff6b6b;background:#ff9d9d;animation:ph3 4.2s linear infinite 1.9s}
@keyframes ph1{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  42%{top:118px;opacity:1}
  47%{top:128px;opacity:0} 100%{top:128px;opacity:0}
}
@keyframes ph2{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  58%{top:226px;opacity:1}
  63%{top:236px;opacity:0} 100%{top:236px;opacity:0}
}
@keyframes ph3{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  76%{top:334px;opacity:1}
  81%{top:344px;opacity:0} 100%{top:344px;opacity:0}
}

/* --- How it works steps --- */
.how{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.how h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.how .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:22px}
.step{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:16px;position:relative;padding-bottom:26px;
}
.step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.step::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:21px;top:44px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:var(--line);
}
.step:last-child::before{display:none}
.step .num{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid var(--accent);
  color:var(--accent);font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.step h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.step p b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}

/* --- Spectrum splitter --- */
.spectrum{
  margin-top:56px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:30px 30px 24px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
.spectrum h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.spectrum .note{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:24px}
.spectrum-bar{
  position:relative;height:56px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,
    #4b0082 0%, #7b2fbe 8%, #2f52e0 17%, #00a3e0 26%, #19d37a 34%,
    #e8e33a 42%, #ff9d2e 50%, #f43b2f 58%, #c22030 68%, #7a1220 78%, #3a0a12 100%);
}
.band{
  position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-inline:1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(1px);transition:filter .2s;
}
.band span{
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.75);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.band:hover{filter:brightness(1.25)}
.b1{left:0;width:31%}
.b2{left:31%;width:24%}
.b3{left:55%;width:45%}
.scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:10px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- Pros / limits --- */
.pl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:56px}
.pl{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.pl h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pl h3 .badge{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.pl.pro h3 .badge{background:rgba(46,204,113,.15);color:#2ecc71}
.pl.con h3 .badge{background:rgba(231,76,60,.15);color:#e74c3c}
.pl ul{list-style:none}
.pl li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pl li:first-child{border-top:0}
.pl li::before{content:"—";color:var(--accent);flex:none}
.pl li b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:840px){.pl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* --- Records table --- */
.records{margin-top:56px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.records .head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:24px 28px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.records h3{font-size:1.1rem}
.records .src{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.1em}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:16px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:13px 28px;font-size:.88rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
th{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);border-top:0}
td b{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent)}
tbody tr{transition:background .2s}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--accent-soft)}
tr.rec td{background:var(--accent-soft)}
tr.rec td b{color:var(--accent-2)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  th,td{padding:11px 16px}
  .hide-sm{display:none}
}

/* --- Applications --- */
.apps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:56px}
.app{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px;background:var(--panel);
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;
}
.app:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.app .num{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.app h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.app p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:840px){.apps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Callout */
.callout{
  margin-top:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),transparent 70%);
  border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 30px;
}
.callout .mark{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.callout p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.callout p b{color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:560px){.callout{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   Footer
   ============================================================ */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:44px 0 52px;background:var(--bg-soft);transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot .brand{font-size:.95rem}
.foot p{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem}
.to-top{
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s,transform .15s;
}

    <span class="kicker reveal">The Big Picture</span>
    <h2 class="reveal d1">Why push efficiency so hard?</h2>
    <p class="lead reveal d1">
      The solar cell is the only major energy device whose cost has fallen roughly
      <b>99% since 1976</b> — but every point of conversion efficiency still matters.
      Higher efficiency means more power per square metre of roof, per kilogram of payload
      on a spacecraft, and per dollar of balance-of-system cost.
    </p>
    <div class="why-grid">
      <div class="card reveal d1">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 21h18M5 21V8l7-5 7 5v13M9 21v-6h6v6"/></svg></div>
        <h3>More power per roof</h3>
        <p>A 26% cell produces ~18% more energy than a 22% cell in the same space. On space-constrained buildings, that directly cuts module count, racking, and installation cost.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal d2">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 14a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M12 14v7M8 21h8M12 6V4M6 8 4.5 6.5M18 8l1.5-1.5"/></svg></div>

      </div>

<!-- ================= MULTI-JUNCTION (FOCUS) ================= -->
<section class="section" id="multi">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker reveal">Deep Dive · The Focus</span>
    <div class="mj-head">
      <h2 class="reveal d1">Multi-junction solar cells</h2>
      <p class="lead reveal d2">
        A single semiconductor can only harvest part of the solar spectrum: photons too energetic
        waste their excess as heat, photons too weak pass right through. A multi-junction cell solves
        this by stacking <b>several sub-cells with different bandgaps</b>, so each slice of the spectrum
        is absorbed by the material best matched to it. The result is the highest efficiency any
        photovoltaic technology has achieved.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- Diagram + how it works -->
    <div class="mj-diagram">
      <div class="stack-panel reveal" role="img" aria-label="Schematic of a triple-junction solar cell: sunlight enters a GaInP sub-cell, then a GaAs sub-cell, then a germanium sub-cell, joined by tunnel junctions and wired in series.">
        <div class="sun-arrow"><span class="ray"></span> Sunlight (AM1.5) <span class="ray"></span></div>
        <div class="stack">
          <div class="photon ph1" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="photon ph2" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="photon ph3" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer contact">Front transparent contact · anti-reflection coating</div>
          <div class="layer sub1">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 1 — GaInP <small>absorbs UV & blue/green (~350–700 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈1.86 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tunnel" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer sub2">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 2 — GaAs <small>absorbs red (~700–870 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈1.42 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tunnel" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer sub3">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 3 — Ge <small>absorbs infrared (~870–1900 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈0.66 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="layer contact">Back ohmic contact (Ge)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stack-legend">
          <span><i class="dot v"></i>Sub-cell 1 voltage V₁</span>
          <span><i class="dot o"></i>Sub-cell 2 voltage V₂</span>
          <span><i class="dot r"></i>Sub-cell 3 voltage V₃</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="how reveal d2">
        <h3>How a multi-junction cell works</h3>
        <p class="sub">Five principles, in the order a photon experiences them.</p>

        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">01</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Spectrum splitting by bandgap</h4>
            <p>Each sub-cell is a p–n junction made from a material with a specific <b>bandgap</b>. A photon can only be absorbed if its energy <b>E = hc/λ</b> meets or exceeds the bandgap. The top cell has the widest gap, so only the most energetic (shortest-wavelength) photons are absorbed there — the rest pass through untouched, because that material is nearly transparent to longer wavelengths.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">02</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Sequential absorption</h4>
            <p>Photons that the top cell lets through reach the middle cell, where the <b>lower bandgap</b> absorbs the next band of the spectrum. Photons surviving both reach the bottom cell, whose <b>narrowest gap</b> catches the infrared tail. Watch the animation: violet light is absorbed high in the stack, orange light in the middle, red light at the bottom.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">03</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Series connection via tunnel junctions</h4>
            <p>Sub-cells are joined by <b>tunnel junctions</b> — ultra-thin, heavily doped p⁺/n⁺ regions where carriers cross by quantum-mechanical tunneling with almost no voltage loss. Electrically this is a <b>series string</b>: the top cell's back contact is the middle cell's front contact, and so on.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">04</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Voltages add — the core advantage</h4>
            <p>In series, the same current flows through every sub-cell, but the output voltage is the <b>sum</b>: V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃. A triple-junction cell can deliver roughly <b>3 V</b> from a stack only ~2 µm thick — far beyond what a single junction can reach. Since power = current × voltage, this directly multiplies the usable energy per photon energy.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">05</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Current matching — the design constraint</h4>
            <p>Because the sub-cells share one current, the stack's current is capped by the <b>weakest sub-cell</b>. Cell designers therefore tune layer thickness, composition (e.g., In content in InGaP), and the solar spectrum assumed at the site so that all sub-cells produce nearly <b>equal photocurrent</b> — "current matching." Under concentration the spectrum shifts, so cells are re-optimized for the concentrator's optics.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Spectrum -->
    <div class="spectrum reveal">
      <h3>One spectrum, three harvesters</h3>
      <p class="note">Idealized split for a GaInP/GaAs/Ge triple-junction under AM1.5. Each dashed zone shows the band one sub-cell is tuned to absorb. Hover the bands.</p>
      <div class="spectrum-bar" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="band b1"><span>GaInP · UV–green</span></div>
        <div class="band b2"><span>GaAs · red</span></div>
        <div class="band b3"><span>Ge · infrared</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="scale"><span>350 nm</span><span>600</span><span>900</span><span>1200</span><span>1900 nm</span></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Pros / limits -->
    <div class="pl-grid">
      <div class="pl pro reveal d1">
        <h3>Strengths <span class="badge">Why they win</span></h3>
        <ul>
          <li><b>Unmatched efficiency</b> — the only technology above 30% at one sun and above 40% with concentration.</li>
          <li><b>High power density</b> — 3–5× the power per unit area of silicon, ideal for spacecraft where every gram counts.</li>
          <li><b>Radiation & temperature resilience</b> — III–V materials degrade far more slowly in space than silicon or perovskite.</li>
          <li><b>Thermal stability</b> — GaAs and Ge keep working where other materials would cook at space or concentrator temperatures.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="pl con reveal d2">
        <h3>Limitations <span class="badge">The trade-offs</span></h3>
        <ul>

Key physics content to explain in detail:

Multi-junction (MJ) cell: several p-n junctions (subcells) stacked vertically in one device. Each subcell is made from a semiconductor with a different bandgap, arranged from largest bandgap at top (front, facing the sun) to smallest at bottom.

Why: the solar spectrum (AM1.5, ~1000 W/m²) spans from UV to near IR. A single junction can only harvest photons above its bandgap, and any excess photon energy above the bandgap is lost to heat (thermalization), while sub-bandgap photons are lost to transmission. This caps the single-junction ideal efficiency at ~33% (Shockley–Queisser).

With multiple junctions:
- The top cell (largest bandgap) absorbs only high-energy (short wavelength) photons, e.g., GaInP (Eg ~1.86 eV) absorbs UV and blue up to ~670 nm.
- Photons below that bandgap are transparent to the top cell and reach the middle cell, GaAs (1.42 eV), which absorbs ~670–870 nm (green, yellow, orange, red).
- The bottom cell, Ge (0.66 eV), absorbs ~870 nm to ~1.9 μm (near IR).

Series connection: subcells share the same current I (they're in series, one common current path). Each subcell produces a photocurrent proportional to the photons it absorbs. - Thermalization: by assigning each photon energy range to a bandgap just below it, the excess energy per photon is minimized.

h2 "Why Efficiency Matters"

Multi-junction section content:

Eyebrow "Focus Section"
h2 "Multi-Junction Solar Cells, In Depth"
Lead: "A multi-junction (MJ) cell stacks two or more semiconductor junctions vertically, each tuned to a different band of the solar spectrum. It is the highest-efficiency photovoltaic architecture ever built — and the design logic behind it is a masterclass in physics."

Diagram card title: "Anatomy of a 3-junction cell" + stack SVG.

Then "How a Multi-Junction Cell Works" — 6 steps:

Step 1 — "Sunlight enters the top cell"
"The stack is arranged from largest bandgap at the top (facing the sun) to smallest at the bottom. In the record NREL cell, that's indium gallium phosphide (GaInP, Eg ≈ 1.86 eV) on top, gallium arsenide (GaAs, Eg ≈ 1.42 eV) in the middle, and germanium (Ge, Eg ≈ 0.66 eV) at the bottom."

Step 2 — "Each subcell absorbs its own slice of the spectrum"
"A semiconductor only absorbs photons with energy at or above its bandgap. So the top cell swallows UV and blue light (wavelengths below ~670 nm) while staying transparent to the rest. The green, yellow, and red photons that slip past it are captured by the middle GaAs cell; the near-IR that remains is finally absorbed by the Ge bottom cell."

Step 3 — "Above-bandgap photons become electric current"
"In every subcell, an absorbed photon excites an electron across the bandgap, creating an electron–hole pair. The junction's built-in electric field separates the pair and drives it to the contacts — the ordinary photovoltaic effect, happening three times in parallel. Because the bandgap of each cell sits just below the energy of the photons it handles, the wasted 'excess' energy (thermalization) per photon is kept small."

Step 4 — "Subcells are wired in series"
"The three subcells are stacked so they form a single series loop. Current flows through all three, so the same current I circulates in the entire device, while the voltages add: V = V_top + V_mid + V_bot ≈ 1.1 + 0.9 + 0.4 ≈ 2.4 V. Thin, heavily doped tunnel junctions between the subcells let current pass by quantum tunneling with almost no voltage loss."

Step 5 — "Current matching is the design constraint"
"Because the subcells share one current, the device can deliver no more than the weakest subcell. Designers therefore tune each layer's bandgap and thickness so that the photocurrents balance under the target spectrum — a condition called current matching. Mismatched subcells simply throttle the output and waste the other cells' absorbed energy as heat."

Step 6 — "The result: beyond the single-junction ceiling"
"An ideal single junction tops out near 33% (Shockley–Queisser), because it must either overheat its bandgap or transmit the spectrum. A multi-junction cell assigns each band of the spectrum to a bandgap chosen just for it, shrinking both thermalization and transmission losses. In practice, 3-junction cells reach ~38% under ~1,000× concentration… hmm — 38.0% under 2000 suns? Let me say: "In practice, three-junction cells have reached 38% under 2,000-sun concentration and a record 47.6% under 500-sun concentration — far above anything a single junction can approach."

Spectrum card: title "Where each subcell works" + spectrum SVG.

Table:
| Subcell | Material | Bandgap | Absorbed range (approx.) | Role |
Top | GaInP (indium gallium phosphide) | ≈ 1.86 eV | ≈ 300–670 nm — UV to blue | Harvests the highest-energy photons; contributes the largest share of the voltage
Middle | GaAs (gallium arsenide) | ≈ 1.42 eV | ≈ 670–870 nm — green to red | Captures the middle of the spectrum where AM1.5 is strongest
Bottom | Ge (germanium) | ≈ 0.66 eV | ≈ 870–1900 nm — near IR | Catches the last low-energy photons; also serves as the cell's substrate

Callout box: "Why not just one thick cell?" — "A single cell must pick one bandgap. Choose it high and most of the spectrum passes straight through (transmission loss); choose it low and abundant low-energy photons dump their excess energy as heat (thermalization). Multi-junction design splits the compromise: many junctions, each taking a narrow, well-matched slice of the spectrum. The theoretical payoff is steep — an ideal 2-junction cell can approach ~45%, a 3-junction ~47%, and each additional junction adds a little more, asymptotically approaching the full-spectrum limit."

Challenges (grid of 4 small cards):
- "Expensive epitaxy" — III-V layers are grown atom-by-atom by MBE or MOCVD; a single cell costs hundreds to thousands of dollars, orders of magnitude above silicon.
- "Lattice matching" — Stacking different alloys without defects requires their crystal lattices to line up (or careful strain engineering), which limits material choices.
- "Thermal management" — Under high concentration, cells run hot; efficiency and reliability depend on keeping temperatures down.
- "Current-matching fragility" — Spectral shifts (temperature, angle, atmosphere) can unbalance the subcells, so the design must stay matched across operating conditions.

Cards:

3. "Terrestrial & Research Frontiers" — "Efforts to cut MJ cost — cheaper substrates, lattice-relaxed stacks, and hybrid perovskite/III-V designs — aim to bring multi-junction performance to ground installations. Meanwhile, perovskite-on-silicon tandems bring a cheaper taste of the same physics to commercial modules."

Future section:
h2 "What Comes Next"
Paragraph + list:
- "Four- and five-junction stacks" — adding junctions to split the spectrum even finer; 4-junction concentrator records already sit in the mid-30s%.
- "Perovskite in the stack" — perovskites are tunable, cheap, and can be deposited at low temperature; hybrid perovskite/III-V and perovskite/silicon tandems aim to combine MJ physics with practical cost.
- "Better tunnel junctions" — every millivolt of tunnel-junction loss is wasted voltage; engineering sharper, thinner junctions lifts the whole stack.
- "Lattice-relaxed and non-matched designs" — freeing subcells from strict lattice matching opens a wider menu of optimal bandgaps.

Glossary (8 terms):
- Bandgap (eV) — the minimum photon energy a semiconductor can absorb; sets which wavelengths a cell sees.
- AM1.5 spectrum — the standard reference solar spectrum at Earth's surface (air mass 1.5), normalized to 1,000 W/m².
- Shockley–Queisser limit — the ~33% theoretical ceiling of an ideal single-junction cell at the AM1.5 spectrum.
- Lattice matching — aligning the atomic spacing of stacked layers so they can be grown together without a rain of defects.
- Tunnel junction — a thin, heavily doped n⁺p⁻ barrier that passes current via quantum tunneling with minimal voltage loss.
- Current matching — tuning subcells so all produce the same current, since the series stack is limited by the weakest.
- Thermalization loss — energy lost as heat when a photon more energetic than the bandgap is absorbed.
- External quantum efficiency (EQE) — the fraction of incident photons at a given wavelength that produce collected charge.

  transition:transform .6s ease,background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
[data-theme="light"] .panel-frame{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3c4a5c,#222c38)}
.panel-frame:hover{transform:rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(5deg)}
.panel-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px;
  height:340px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;
}
.cell{
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(200deg,#123048,#0b1a2a 70%);
  border:1px solid rgba(120,180,255,.14);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cell::after{ /* busbar lines */
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 46%,rgba(180,215,255,.22) 48%,rgba(180,215,255,.22) 52%,transparent 54%);
}
.panel-frame::after{ /* shimmer sweep */
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:9px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,210,130,.16) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 50%,rgba(255,210,130,.16) 52%,transparent 70%);
  transform:translateX(-120%);animation:sweep 6.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sweep{0%,55%{transform:translateX(-120%)}85%,100%{transform:translateX(120%)}}
.panel-caption{
  position:absolute;bottom:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  white-space:nowrap;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;
}

@media (max-width:920px){
  .hero{padding-top:130px}
  .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:64px}
  .panel-stage{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .panel-grid{height:260px}
}

/* ============================================================
   Reveal on scroll
   ============================================================ */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.reveal.d2{transition-delay:.16s}
.reveal.d3{transition-delay:.24s}.reveal.d4{transition-delay:.32s}

/* ============================================================
   Section: why efficiency / overview
   ============================================================ */
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:52px}
.card{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:28px 26px;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.card .ico{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:18px;
}
.card .ico svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.card h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem}
@media (max-width:840px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   Section: technologies
   ============================================================ */
#technologies{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);transition:background .45s}
.tech-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:52px}
.tech{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.tech:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.tech .tag{
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);
}
.tech h3{font-size:1.05rem}
.tech p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;flex:1}
.tech .eff{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:14px;
}
.tech .eff b{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--cyan)}
.tech .eff span{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--faint)}
.tech.featured{
  grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--panel) 55%);
  border-color:var(--accent);
}
[data-theme="light"] .tech.featured{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),#fff 55%)}
.tech.featured h3{font-size:1.35rem}
.tech.featured .deep{
  align-self:center;justify-self:start;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:var(--accent);color:#181004;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;
  font-size:.86rem;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .25s;
}
.tech.featured .deep:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px -10px var(--glow)}
@media (max-width:840px){
  .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tech.featured{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tech.featured .deep{align-self:start;justify-self:start}
}

/* Efficiency bar chart */
.chart{margin-top:64px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:34px 34px 26px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.chart h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.chart .note{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:26px}
.bar-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(120px,220px) 1fr 64px;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.bar-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.bar-label{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bar-track{background:var(--track);height:14px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bar-fill{
  height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
  transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.bar-fill.cool{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3ba7c9,var(--cyan))}
.bar-val{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.9rem;text-align:right;color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .bar-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 54px;grid-template-areas:"l l" "t v"}
  .bar-label{grid-area:l}.bar-track{grid-area:t}.bar-val{grid-area:v}
}

/* ============================================================
   Section: multi-junction (the focus)
   ============================================================ */
#multi{position:relative}
#multi::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:min(900px,90%);height:220px;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,var(--sun-halo),transparent 70%);
}
.mj-head{max-width:760px;margin-bottom:20px}
.mj-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,2.9rem)}

/* --- Stack diagram --- */
.mj-diagram{
  margin-top:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:34px;align-items:start;
}
.stack-panel{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;
  padding:30px 26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
.sun-arrow{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--accent);font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.sun-arrow .ray{width:2px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(var(--accent),transparent);animation:ray 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ray{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:translateY(-2px)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(3px)}}
.stack{position:relative;margin:6px auto 4px;max-width:520px}
.layer{
  position:relative;border-radius:10px;margin:0 auto 0;width:100%;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;
  padding:0 18px;
}
.layer .name{font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
.layer .name small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem}
.layer .gap{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);opacity:.85;white-space:nowrap}
.layer.contact{
  background:var(--panel-2);height:38px;justify-content:center;
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
}
.sub1{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(124,110,255,.34),rgba(124,110,255,.16));border-color:rgba(140,130,255,.5)}
.sub2{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,122,60,.36),rgba(255,122,60,.16));border-color:rgba(255,140,80,.5)}
.sub3{height:96px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(230,57,70,.34),rgba(230,57,70,.16));border-color:rgba(240,80,90,.5)}
.tunnel{
  height:12px;margin:0 auto;width:82%;border-radius:4px;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--faint) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px);
  opacity:.55;position:relative;
}
.tunnel::after{
  content:"tunnel junction";position:absolute;right:calc(-1 * 100% + 8px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--faint);
  text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;display:none;
}
.stack-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stack-legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted)}
.dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.dot.v{background:#7c6eff}.dot.o{background:#ff7a3c}.dot.r{background:#e63946}

/* photons animation */
.photon{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-16px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
  box-shadow:0 0 12px 3px currentColor;
}
.ph1{color:#8f83ff;background:#b7b0ff;animation:ph1 4.2s linear infinite .3s}
.ph2{color:#ff9a55;background:#ffc49a;animation:ph2 4.2s linear infinite 1.1s}
.ph3{color:#ff6b6b;background:#ff9d9d;animation:ph3 4.2s linear infinite 1.9s}
@keyframes ph1{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  42%{top:56px;opacity:1}
  47%{top:66px;opacity:0} 100%{top:66px;opacity:0}
}
@keyframes ph2{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  58%{top:152px;opacity:1}
  63%{top:162px;opacity:0} 100%{top:162px;opacity:0}
}
@keyframes ph3{
  0%{top:-16px;opacity:0} 6%{opacity:1}
  76%{top:248px;opacity:1}
  81%{top:258px;opacity:0} 100%{top:258px;opacity:0}
}

/* --- How it works steps --- */
.how{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.how h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.how .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:22px}
.step{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:16px;position:relative;padding-bottom:26px;
}
.step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.step::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:21px;top:44px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:var(--line);
}
.step:last-child::before{display:none}
.step .num{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid var(--accent);
  color:var(--accent);font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.step h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.step p b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}

/* --- Spectrum splitter --- */
.spectrum{
  margin-top:56px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
  padding:30px 30px 24px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s;
}
.spectrum h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.spectrum .note{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:24px}
.spectrum-bar{
  position:relative;height:56px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,
    #4b0082 0%, #7b2fbe 8%, #2f52e0 17%, #00a3e0 26%, #19d37a 34%,
    #e8e33a 42%, #ff9d2e 50%, #f43b2f 58%, #c22030 68%, #7a1220 78%, #3a0a12 100%);
}
.band{
  position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-inline:1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(1px);transition:filter .2s;
}
.band span{
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.75);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.band:hover{filter:brightness(1.25)}
.b1{left:0;width:31%}
.b2{left:31%;width:24%}
.b3{left:55%;width:45%}
.scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:10px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- Pros / limits --- */
.pl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:56px}
.pl{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.pl h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pl h3 .badge{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.pl.pro h3 .badge{background:rgba(46,204,113,.15);color:#2ecc71}
.pl.con h3 .badge{background:rgba(231,76,60,.15);color:#e74c3c}
.pl ul{list-style:none}
.pl li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pl li:first-child{border-top:0}
.pl li::before{content:"—";color:var(--accent);flex:none}
.pl li b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:840px){.pl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* --- Records table --- */
.records{margin-top:56px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.records .head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:24px 28px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.records h3{font-size:1.1rem}
.records .src{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.1em}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:16px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:13px 28px;font-size:.88rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
th{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);border-top:0}
td b{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent)}
tbody tr{transition:background .2s}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--accent-soft)}
tr.rec td{background:var(--accent-soft)}
tr.rec td b{color:var(--accent-2)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  th,td{padding:11px 16px}
  .hide-sm{display:none}
}

/* --- Applications --- */
.apps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:56px}
.app{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px;background:var(--panel);
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .3s,background .45s;
}
.app:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.app .num{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--faint);display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.app h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.app p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:840px){.apps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Callout */
.callout{
  margin-top:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent-soft),transparent 70%);
  border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 30px;
}
.callout .mark{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.callout p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.callout p b{color:var(--text)}
@media (max-width:560px){.callout{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============================================================
   Footer
   ============================================================ */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:44px 0 52px;background:var(--bg-soft);transition:background .45s,border-color .45s}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot .brand{font-size:.95rem}
.foot p{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem}
.to-top{
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s,transform .15s;
}
.to-top:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   Motion preferences
   ============================================================ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none !important;transition:none !important}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker reveal">The Big Picture</span>
    <h2 class="reveal d1">Why push efficiency so hard?</h2>
    <p class="lead reveal d1">
      The solar cell is the only major energy device whose cost has fallen roughly
      <b>99% since 1976</b> — but every point of conversion efficiency still matters.
      Higher efficiency means more power per square metre of roof, per kilogram of payload
      on a spacecraft, and per dollar of balance-of-system cost.
    </p>
    <div class="why-grid">
      <div class="card reveal d1">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 21h18M5 21V8l7-5 7 5v13M9 21v-6h6v6"/></svg></div>
        <h3>More power per roof</h3>
        <p>A 26% cell produces ~18% more energy than a 22% cell in the same space. On space-constrained buildings, that directly cuts module count, racking, and installation cost.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal d2">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 14a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M12 14v7M8 21h8M12 6V4M6 8 4.5 6.5M18 8l1.5-1.5"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Lower levelized cost</h3>
        <p>Modules are the smallest cost share of a solar plant. Gains in efficiency reduce module area, inverter load, wiring, and land — shrinking the cost of every kilowatt-hour.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal d3">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2 4 6v6c0 5 3.4 8.6 8 10 4.6-1.4 8-5 8-10V6l-8-4z"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Space & critical missions</h3>
        <p>In orbit, mass is the true currency. Multi-junction cells deliver the highest power-to-mass ratio of any technology — which is why they power nearly every spacecraft.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= TECHNOLOGIES ================= -->
<section class="section" id="technologies">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker reveal">The Landscape</span>
    <h2 class="reveal d1">Where high efficiency comes from today</h2>
    <p class="lead reveal d1">
      Three families dominate the frontier: advanced crystalline silicon, emerging perovskites,
      and compound multi-junction devices. Each trades material cost, maturity, and ceiling differently.
    </p>

    <div class="tech-grid">
      <div class="tech reveal d1">
        <span class="tag">Silicon · Mature</span>
        <h3>PERC & TOPCon</h3>
        <p>Textured silicon with passivated rear contacts and tunnel-oxide layers. TOPCon replaces the aluminum back field with a tunnel oxide and crystalline silicon contact, squeezing out 1–2 extra points.</p>
        <div class="eff"><b>~26.8%</b><span>research record, 1 sun</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tech reveal d2">
        <span class="tag">Silicon · Emerging</span>
        <h3>Heterojunction (HJT)</h3>
        <p>Amorphous-silicon passivation on both faces of a crystalline wafer. Lower temperature processing, excellent light-induced-stability behavior, and a natural platform for tandems.</p>
        <div class="eff"><b>~26.9%</b><span>research record, 1 sun</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tech reveal d3">
        <span class="tag">Hybrid · Breakthrough</span>
        <h3>Perovskite–Silicon Tandem</h3>
        <p>A thin perovskite front cell absorbs the blue; silicon collects the red and infrared. Already the fastest-rising technology on the efficiency record chart.</p>
        <div class="eff"><b>33.9%</b><span>record, 1 sun</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tech featured reveal d2">
        <div>
          <span class="tag">III–V Compound · Frontier</span>
          <h3>Multi-Junction Solar Cells</h3>
          <p>
            Several sub-cells of different materials are stacked and electrically wired in series.
            Each sub-cell is tuned to a slice of the solar spectrum, so the stack harvests far more
            of the sun's energy than any single material can — reaching <b>32.8% at one sun</b>
            and beyond <b>47% under concentration</b>. The technology that powers space,
            concentrating power plants, and the world's efficiency records.
          </p>
        </div>
        <a class="deep" href="#multi">
          How they work, in detail
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Bar chart -->
    <div class="chart reveal">
      <h3>Conversion efficiency — research records</h3>
      <p class="note">Single-sun unless noted. Bars scaled to the 47.6% maximum. *NREL Best Research Cell Efficiency Chart.</p>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">c-Si (PERC/TOPCon)</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill cool" data-w="56.3"></div></div><span class="bar-val">26.8%</span></div>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">Perovskite single-junction</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill cool" data-w="54.8"></div></div><span class="bar-val">26.1%</span></div>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">3J III–V, 1 sun</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" data-w="68.9"></div></div><span class="bar-val">32.8%</span></div>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">Perovskite–Si tandem</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" data-w="71.2"></div></div><span class="bar-val">33.9%</span></div>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">3J III–V, concentrated</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" data-w="85.5"></div></div><span class="bar-val">40.7%</span></div>
      <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">4J III–V, concentrated</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" data-w="100"></div></div><span class="bar-val">47.6%</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= MULTI-JUNCTION (FOCUS) ================= -->
<section class="section" id="multi">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker reveal">Deep Dive · The Focus</span>
    <div class="mj-head">
      <h2 class="reveal d1">Multi-junction solar cells</h2>
      <p class="lead reveal d2">
        A single semiconductor can only harvest part of the solar spectrum: photons too energetic
        waste their excess as heat, photons too weak pass right through. A multi-junction cell solves
        this by stacking <b>several sub-cells with different bandgaps</b>, so each slice of the spectrum
        is absorbed by the material best matched to it. The result is the highest efficiency any
        photovoltaic technology has achieved.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- Diagram + how it works -->
    <div class="mj-diagram">
      <div class="stack-panel reveal" role="img" aria-label="Schematic of a triple-junction solar cell: sunlight enters a GaInP sub-cell, then a GaAs sub-cell, then a germanium sub-cell, joined by tunnel junctions and wired in series.">
        <div class="sun-arrow"><span class="ray"></span> Sunlight (AM1.5) <span class="ray"></span></div>
        <div class="stack">
          <div class="photon ph1" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="photon ph2" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="photon ph3" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer contact">Front transparent contact · anti-reflection coating</div>
          <div class="layer sub1">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 1 — GaInP <small>absorbs UV & blue/green (~350–700 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈1.86 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tunnel" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer sub2">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 2 — GaAs <small>absorbs red (~700–870 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈1.42 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tunnel" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="layer sub3">
            <span class="name">Sub-cell 3 — Ge <small>absorbs infrared (~870–1900 nm)</small></span>
            <span class="gap">≈0.66 eV</span>
          </div>
          <div class="layer contact">Back ohmic contact (Ge)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stack-legend">
          <span><i class="dot v"></i>Sub-cell 1 voltage V₁</span>
          <span><i class="dot o"></i>Sub-cell 2 voltage V₂</span>
          <span><i class="dot r"></i>Sub-cell 3 voltage V₃</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="how reveal d2">
        <h3>How a multi-junction cell works</h3>
        <p class="sub">Five principles, in the order a photon experiences them.</p>

        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">01</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Spectrum splitting by bandgap</h4>
            <p>Each sub-cell is a p–n junction made from a material with a specific <b>bandgap</b>. A photon can only be absorbed if its energy <b>E = hc/λ</b> meets or exceeds the bandgap. The top cell has the widest gap, so only the most energetic (shortest-wavelength) photons are absorbed there — the rest pass through untouched, because that material is nearly transparent to longer wavelengths.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">02</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Sequential absorption</h4>
            <p>Photons that the top cell lets through reach the middle cell, where the <b>lower bandgap</b> absorbs the next band of the spectrum. Photons surviving both reach the bottom cell, whose <b>narrowest gap</b> catches the infrared tail. Watch the animation: violet light stops high, green light stops in the middle, red light reaches the bottom.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">03</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Series connection via tunnel junctions</h4>
            <p>Sub-cells are joined by <b>tunnel junctions</b> — ultra-thin, heavily doped p⁺/n⁺ regions where carriers cross by quantum-mechanical tunneling with almost no voltage loss. Electrically this is a <b>series string</b>: the top cell's back contact is the middle cell's front contact, and so on.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">04</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Voltages add — the core advantage</h4>
            <p>In series, the same current flows through every sub-cell, but the output voltage is the <b>sum</b>: V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃. A triple-junction cell can deliver roughly <b>3 V</b> from a stack only ~2 µm thick — far beyond what a single junction can reach. Since power = current × voltage, this directly multiplies the usable energy per photon energy.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="step">
          <div class="num">05</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Current matching — the design constraint</h4>
            <p>Because the sub-cells share one current, the stack's current is capped by the <b>weakest sub-cell</b>. Cell designers therefore tune layer thickness, composition (e.g., In content in InGaP), and the solar spectrum assumed at the site so that all sub-cells produce nearly <b>equal photocurrent</b> — "current matching." Under concentration the spectrum shifts, so cells are re-optimized for the concentrator's optics.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Spectrum -->
    <div class="spectrum reveal">
      <h3>One spectrum, three harvesters</h3>
      <p class="note">Idealized split for a GaInP/GaAs/Ge triple-junction under AM1.5. Each dashed zone shows the band one sub-cell is tuned to absorb. Hover the bands.</p>
      <div class="spectrum-bar" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="band b1"><span>GaInP · UV–green</span></div>
        <div class="band b2"><span>GaAs · red</span></div>
        <div class="band b3"><span>Ge · infrared</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="scale"><span>350 nm</span><span>600</span><span>900</span><span>1200</span><span>1900 nm</span></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Pros / limits -->
    <div class="pl-grid">
      <div class="pl pro reveal d1">
        <h3>Strengths <span class="badge">Why they win</span></h3>
        <ul>
          <li><b>Unmatched efficiency</b> — the only technology above 30% at one sun and above 40% with concentration.</li>
          <li><b>High power density</b> — 3–5× the power per unit area of silicon, ideal for spacecraft where every gram counts.</li>
          <li><b>Radiation & temperature resilience</b> — III–V materials degrade far more slowly in space than silicon or perovskite.</li>
          <li><b>Thermal stability</b> — GaAs and Ge keep working where other materials would cook at space or concentrator temperatures.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="pl con reveal d2">
        <h3>Limitations <span class="badge">The trade-offs</span></h3>
        <ul>
          <li><b>Cost</b> — epitaxial III–V growth on GaAs or Ge is far pricier than wafer-based silicon; the technology is only competitive where cost-per-watt is relaxed (space, CPV) or area is tiny.</li>
          <li><b>Current matching</b> — one weak sub-cell throttles the whole stack, demanding precise growth and design.</li>
          <li><b>Lattice strain</b> — stacking mismatched materials builds mechanical stress; "metamorphic" designs buffer it with graded layers, at the cost of added complexity.</li>
          <li><b>Spectrum dependence</b> — a cell matched to AM0 (space) isn't optimal at AM1.5 (ground), and vice versa.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Records -->
    <div class="records reveal" id="records">
      <div class="head">
        <h3>Efficiency records — multi-junction vs. the field</h3>
        <span class="src">* NREL Best Research Cell Efficiency Chart</span>
      </div>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr><th>Device</th><th>Record</th><th>Conditions</th><th class="hide-sm">Notes</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Single-junction silicon</td><td><b>26.8%</b></td><td>1 sun</td><td class="hide-sm">Passivated-perc / TOPCon, ~2 cm² class</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Two-junction III–V</td><td><b>35.9%</b></td><td>Concentrated</td><td class="hide-sm">InGaP / InGaAlAs-based</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Three-junction III–V</td><td><b>32.8%</b></td><td>1 sun</td><td class="hide-sm">InGaP / GaAs / Ge — the space-standard design</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Three-junction III–V</td><td><b>40.7%</b></td><td>Concentrated</td><td class="hide-sm">Same stack, ~300–500× sunlight</td></tr>
          <tr class="rec"><td>Four-junction metamorphic</td><td><b>47.6%</b></td><td>Concentrated</td><td class="hide-sm">All-time record; graded layers relax strain</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <!-- Applications -->
    <div class="apps">
      <div class="app reveal d1">
        <span class="num">APPLICATION · 01</span>
        <h4>Space & satellites</h4>
        <p>Almost every modern spacecraft — from GPS constellations to the James Webb Space Telescope — is powered by triple-junction GaInP/GaAs/Ge arrays, chosen for record power-to-mass and decades of radiation tolerance.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="app reveal d2">
        <span class="num">APPLICATION · 02</span>
        <h4>Concentrating photovoltaics (CPV)</h4>
        <p>On the ground, lenses or mirrors focus 300–600 suns onto centimeter-scale multi-junction cells. Because cell cost is a small fraction of a CPV plant's cost, the optics pay back the expensive chip — with a tiny land footprint.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="app reveal d3">
        <span class="num">APPLICATION · 03</span>
        <h4>Micro-power & research</h4>
        <p>Millimeter-scale cells power wearables, IoT sensors, and lab instruments where the simplest, densest, longest-lived source wins. They also serve as the benchmark against which every new photovoltaic material is measured.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="callout reveal">
      <div class="mark" aria-hidden="true">☀</div>
      <p>
        <b>The physics takeaway:</b> a multi-junction cell is, in essence, a prism made of semiconductor.
        By splitting the solar spectrum across stacked bandgaps and summing the voltages of each
        sub-cell in series, it approaches the thermodynamic limit of concentrated light — the
        ~86% of the Shockley–Queisser ceiling that no single junction can ever touch.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<!-- ================= FOOTER ================= -->
<footer>
  <div class="wrap foot">
    <a class="brand" href="#top">
      <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      Heliovolt
    </a>
    <p>Independent educational overview · figures from the NREL Best Research Cell Efficiency Chart · © <span id="year"></span></p>
    <a class="to-top" href="#top">Back to top ↑</a>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var root = document.documentElement;

  /* ---------- Theme: dark default, persisted ---------- */
  var stored = null;
  try { stored = localStorage.getItem("heliovolt-theme"); } catch(e){}
  if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark") root.setAttribute("data-theme", stored);

  var themeBtn = document.getElementById("themeBtn");
  function currentTheme(){ return root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "light" ? "light" : "dark"; }
  function syncBtn(){
    var light = currentTheme() === "light";
    themeBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(light));
    themeBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", light ? "Switch to dark theme" : "Switch to light theme");
  }
  themeBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    var next = currentTheme() === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    try { localStorage.setItem("heliovolt-theme", next); } catch(e){}
    syncBtn();
  });
  syncBtn();

  /* ---------- Nav scroll state ---------- */
  var nav = document.getElementById("nav");
  function onScroll(){ nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", window.scrollY > 12); }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, {passive:true});
  onScroll();

  /* ---------- Mobile menu ---------- */
  var burger = document.getElementById("burger");
  var links = document.getElementById("navLinks");
  burger.addEventListener("click", function(){
    var open = links.classList.toggle("open");
    burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
  });
  links.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    if (e.target.tagName === "A"){ links.classList.remove("open"); burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); }
  });

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll + bar fills ---------- */
  var reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(en){
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        en.target.classList.add("in");
        en.target.querySelectorAll(".bar-fill").forEach(function(b){
          b.style.width = b.dataset.w + "%";
        });
        io.unobserve(en.target);
      });
    }, {threshold: .18});
    reveals.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    reveals.forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.add("in");
      el.querySelectorAll(".bar-fill").forEach(function(b){ b.style.width = b.dataset.w + "%"; });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Footer year ---------- */
  document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
